title: Create a List
shortDescription: Create a List is available within Recruitment & Research and within Sales Tools on the left side bar navigation menu.
body:
**Create a List** is available within **Recruitment & Research** and within **Sales Tools**. Use the left side bar navigation panel to select either Recruitment & Research or Sales Tools. Using Create a List, you can develop a summary of a list of providers that meet your selected criteria. Some examples of what the summary list can be used for are: * Size the market for a specific specialty. * Set up a recruiting plan. * Understand how your network ranks for a specific specialty or all specialties. * If you include a comparison network, this summary list can be used to view overlap and exclusive provider counts. **Note:** The Create a List function utilizes the **Specialty Mapping** option that was already created. You can view the Specialty Mapping options in the drop-down in the upper right corner of the screen. ## Usage Quick Reference To use this module, first enter your desired search criteria and then click the **Go** button. The Summary Results will appear. You can save this as a list or export it. You can view the details by clicking one of the linked numbers in the results to see a detailed list of providers. The Summary and the details can then be viewed on screen, saved to My Things, or exported as a .pdf or .csv file.

Search Criteria
Most fields within the search criteria work as autosuggest lists. As you begin typing content into a field, the list will be populated with matching options. ![Image showing Search Criteria for Create a Lis](/cms/cms-assets/media/landing-page.png "Create a List Search Criteria") ## Geography You can select multiple cities, counties, MSAs, state abbreviations, the name of a population file, or zip codes (3-digit or 5-digit). The system does not permit searching on other partial zip codes or free form text. **NOTE:** If the **Geography** field is left blank, all geographies will be included in the project. Therefore, if you are in a national project and want to search for all providers within the nation, you should leave the geography field blank. Keep in mind that searches with large geographic areas or densely populated geographic areas will take longer to complete. When you select multiple geographies, the search uses **or** logic, therefore, if you enter **Johnson County, KS** and **Topeka, KS MSA** you will see providers that are in either geography. They do not have to be in both. ### Standard Search The Standard Search allows you to begin typing text within the search bar and select from the matching options from the autosuggest list. This can be done multiple times to add each geography needed. It can also be a combination of cities, zip codes, counties, etc. ![Image showing Geography field and selected cities, zip codes, counties, etc.](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_geography_multiple.png "Adding Geography in Create a list module. ") ### Population File The option to create a **Population File** is available within the **Geography** dropdown list. The format of the uploaded file can be: .csv, .txt, .dat, or .xlsx. For more details see: Population Files. ![Image showing selecting Population file for Geography field ](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_geography_popfile.png "Selecting Population file in Geography") For more details on creating and using Population Files, please refer to [Population File](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/population-file) help content. ### Bulk Search By clicking on the **Clipboard** icon, you can paste a list of up to 200 zip codes. ![Image showing Bulk search through Zip codes](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_geography_bulk.png "Bulk search in Geography") For more details on using Bulk search, please refer to [Bulk Search](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/bulk-search) help content. ### Radius Search A radius search means that you can search for providers within the specified radius from the centroid of one or more zip codes. Click the **Radius Search** icon and input a radius in miles and the zip code(s). ![Image showing Radius search in Create a List](/cms/cms-assets/media/radius-search.png "Radius search in Create a List") For more details on using Radius search, please refer to [Radius Search](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/radius-search) help content. **NOTE:** The Radius dropdown list also contains an option to create a **Population File**. ## Networks This list of available networks is filtered by your selected geography. If you don’t select any geographic criteria, then you will see all networks associated with your project. When you select multiple networks, the search returns the counts for each network, all selected networks together, and the market total. If you choose **Select All My Networks**, each of **My Networks** will be listed within the network field. If you choose the shortcut **All my networks,** you will see **All my networks** in the network field. Note that **All my networks** will include any networks in the **My Networks** category AND any published network (a model network that is published). ![Image of Networks in Create a List](/cms/cms-assets/media/search-criteria-networks.png "Networks in Create a List") The Networks dropdown list also provides buttons to easily Select All, Select All My Networks, and Select All Competitor Networks. ## Specialties Within this field, you can select specialty groups or provider types. A project's list of specialty groups is determined by the selected specialty mapping which categorizes specialties into specialty groups and provider types. In the **Specialties** dropdown, you can choose the provider types or specialty groups that you want to use in your analysis. The specialty mapping used in the analysis is determined by your selected specialty mapping in the top right corner of the screen. ![Image showing Specialty mapping selection ](/cms/cms-assets/media/search-criteria-specialties.png "Selecting Specialty mapping") To view more details about the mapping, go to **Settings > Project Setting** and click on your desired specialty mapping. This dropdown list is ordered by the Provider Types listed first and then followed by the specialty groups listed in alphabetical order. You can select one or more provider-type specialties and specialty groups. Provider types can be distinguished from specialty groups by the inclusion of the ‘- Provider Type’ descriptor. ![Image showing selecting of Specialties in Create a List](/cms/cms-assets/media/search-criteria-specialties1.png "Specialties in Create a List") ## NPIs Entering a single digit will list all the Providers with NPIs starting with the entered number. You can select a single NPI or multiple NPIs. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/npis.png) ## Comparison Network Selecting a Comparison Network will include the number of overlap and exclusive providers when comparing to a base network. Entering a single digit will list all the Providers with NPIs starting with the entered number. You can select a single NPI or multiple NPIs. ![Image of Comparision Network create a list](/cms/cms-assets/media/search-criteria-comparison-network.png "Comparision Network") ## Advanced Criteria Advanced Criteria includes Address Confidence, Specialty Confidence and Other options. Address Confidence and Specialty Confidence options indicate the accuracy confidence of the data returned in the search. Selecting Advanced Criteria is optional. To use the Advanced Criteria section, click **Show advanced options**. The options are: * Address Confidence * Low * Medium * High * Specialty Confidence * Low * Medium * High * Other * Confirmed practicing only * New providers only For more information on Address and Specialty Confidence, see [Confidence Scores](/#!/help/sections/glossary?s=c&t=confidence-scores) in the Glossary. For more information see [Confirmed Practicing](/#!/help/sections/glossary?s=c&t=confirmed-practicing) in the Glossary.[](/#!/help/sections/glossary?s=c&t=confirmed-practicing) For more information see [New Providers](/#!/help/sections/glossary?s=n&t=new-providers) in the Glossary. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/advanced-options1.png) For Address Confidence and Specialty Confidence, you can select a single option or a combination of two selections without a gap, like high and medium, or medium and low. Address Confidence represents the level of certainty that an address for a particular provider is valid. For Specialty Confidence, specialties that appear in the NPI Database for a provider are given a higher score. A high score means a significant number of sources confirm the address or specialty, so it can be relied upon with some degree of confidence. For the Other advanced option, to find only confirmed practicing providers, check the **Confirmed practicing only** check box. To find only new providers, check the **New providers only** check box. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/attributes-criteria.png) The Attributes filter is a client specific (custom) filter in core Network360’s Create a List module. With this filter, you can create lists of providers with specific, client-defined attributes. For more information on Attributes Filter, refer to [Attributes Filter](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/attributes-filter) help content. Once you finish selecting your search criteria, click the **Go** button. Then, the Summary Results page will display.

Summary Results
The Summary Results are in the form of a table. Within this table, the provider counts in blue are clickable. To see the corresponding detail list, click on the blue number. You can Save List, which will be saved to My Things, and you can also export the results by clicking the Export button and choosing either the .pdf or .csv format for your export. ![Image showing Summary Results in Create a List](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_summaryresults_1.png "Summary Results page") The Summary Results contains the counts of: * **Unique Providers –** This is the number of individual providers within the network. * **Provider Locations –** This number is a count of each provider at each location where they practice. * **Locations per Provider –** This is a calculation of the number of locations divided by the number of providers. * **Offices –** This is the number of offices that the providers belong to, showing each location once, regardless of the number of providers at each location. Also referred to as Location. * **Unique Adds –** This indicates the number of providers that were added since the last time the network data was updated. * **Unique Drops –** This indicates the number of providers that were removed since the last time the network data was updated. * **Exclusive Providers –** This is only populated when a Comparison Network has been selected, otherwise, n/a is displayed in this column. The number represents the number of providers out of the number of unique providers exclusive to that network. **Note:** Determining Exclusivity Exclusivity is determined at the unique provider level, so if a Provider A is in Plan 1 and Plan 2 at any location or with any specialty, Provider A will be counted as overlap. If Provider A is in Plan 1 and not in Plan 2 at any location or with any specialty, Provider A will be counted as exclusive. **Note:** 0 in the Exclusive column is typically shown for the selected comparison network. * **Overlapping Providers –** This is only populated when a Comparison Network has been selected, otherwise, n/a is displayed in this column. The number represents the number of providers out of the number of unique providers that are in both networks. The **All selected networks** results convey the counts of unique providers for any of the selected networks; this means that when providers are in multiple networks, the providers will be counted only once in the **All selected network**s count. The **Market Total** results convey the count of unique providers in any network within your project. ### Saving the Summary Results To Save the Summary Results: 1. Click on the **Save List** button. A field gets displayed. Enter a name for the saved list. 2. Optionally, you can select the **Shared** check box to have the list be available for other users. 3. Click the Save button. The list will be saved to **My Things > My Provider Lists** and a confirmation message will display. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_save.png) ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_save_confirmation.png) ### Exporting the Summary Results To export a .csv or .pdf of the Summary Results, click the dropdown arrow within the Export button and make your file type selection. If you do not select a file type and just click the Export button, the default format of the export will be a .pdf. A message will display to let you know the export process has begun. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/exporting-summaryresults_create-a-list.png) Once the Export is ready to be downloaded an additional message will be displayed with a summary of your search criteria and a link to Download results. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/exporting-summaryresults1_create-a-list.png) Click the **Download results** link to save it locally. The PDF file will have a cover page listing your search criteria and your summary results on subsequent pages. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/provider-summary-results_create-a-list.png) ### Changing Your Selected Criteria To change your criteria after you see the summary results, click the **Edit Criteria** link to re-open the criteria selection page. Make changes as needed and click the **Go** button.

Detail Results
Each number within the Summary Results that is blue is a link to view more details specific to that number. For example, if you want to see the specific providers that were added to a specific network since the last network data update, click on the number in the Unique Adds column. Selecting to view the details of any of the **All selected Networks**, or **Market Total** (summary rows) can give you a network status for all networks within the selected category at the same time. The Details view displays a list of the providers and indications of the number of My Networks and Competitor Networks in which the provider participates. To see the list of networks, you need to click on the provider's name or the linked results in either of the network columns. * All my networks All my networks represent the total number of distinct providers that meet the search criteria in my networks (combined). * All competitor networks All competitor networks represent the total number of distinct providers that meet the search criteria in their competitors’ networks (combined). * All project networks All project networks represent the total number of distinct providers that meet the search criteria in the entire project. * Market Total Market Total is the total number of distinct providers in the entire project geography, whether or not they are part of a client or competitor network. Market Total conveys the count of unique providers in any network within your project. ## Viewing the Details To view the specifics of the results, the criteria shown on the **Detail Results** page is revised to match your chosen options from the summary results. For example, if you originally searched for HealthyStart and Prime Health, and then click on the results for HealthyStart, then the networks criteria on the **Detail Results** page will display Healthy Start. To see information for the other networks in your original search, return to the **Summary Results** page and make your selections. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_details_markettotal.png) You can view the results as either a list or within a map by clicking the List or **Map** tab. Both the List and the Map views will display your selected criteria and a link back to the **Summary Results** page. ### List View When you click in to view the details, the List view displays. If this list is longer than what can fit on the screen, simply scroll down the page and the list continues to load automatically. The entire list is available to view even if it is large. #### Provider Name Links Each provider name is a link to open additional details about that provider. The provider’s ID and NPI is in the top right corner of the provider profile page. For more information on Provider Details, refer to [Provider Details](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/provider-profile-1) help content. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_details_providersatlocationsummary.png) ### Map View Click on the Map tab to view the providers on a map. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_details_mapview.png) You can zoom in or out on the map by using the + and – icons in the upper left corner of the map. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_detail_zoom.png) When there are multiple providers within a short distance on the map, a Cluster icon will be shown. When you click on that Cluster icon, the map will expand to show the providers within that area. At times there with be a Cluster icon to indicated multiple providers in a single location. When you click on a Cluster icon with that scenario, a Confidence icon will display for each provider at that location. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_details_mapview_group.png) If you hover over a Confidence icon, a pop-up box will display with the provider’s name and location information. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_details_mapview_hover.png) ### Tags Provider Tags are user-assigned notations for providers. You can create your own tags and assign them to providers as needed. Tags can be added at the Provider level or at the Provider at the specific location level. For more information on creating and assigning Tags, refer to [Tags](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/tags) help content. [](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/tags) ### Save Details List This is the same as Saving the List View. ### Exporting a Details List The Details List can be exported as a .csv file. To export, click the **Export** button. The default export type is **Provider List Details**. For more details on using Concise Office List and Concise Provider List, refer [Concise Office List](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/concise-office-list) and [Concise Provider List](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/concise-provider-list) help contents. You can select the required columns you want to include in your export, such as Networks (when you choose networks you can then select either summary or specialty details), Tags, Provider Comments, and/or Custom Attributes (if applicable). Then, click on **Export CSV** button. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/consice-export.png) A message will be displayed to let you know that the export process has begun. Once the Export is ready to be downloaded, an additional message will be displayed with a summary of your search criteria and a link to **Download results**. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/creatalist_details_export_messages.png) When you select **Networks** with **Summary**, your export will include a Network column for each provider-location in the Detail Results and the specialty will be the best match from all the networks. When you select **Networks** with **Specialty Details**, your export will include all provider-location-specialty combinations, rather than only the best match specialty. When you select **Networks** with either **Summary** or **Specialty Details**, **Par Indicator** (Participating Indicator) codes are included in the Network column(s) for each provider-location-specialty combination in the export file. #### Par Indicator Codes The definitions of each Par indicator code are: * PLS: Participating at this location AND with this specialty* * PL: Participating at this location but with a different specialty * PS: Participating with this specialty but at a different location* * P: Participating at a different location and with a different specialty * N: Non-Participating \*The PLS and PS codes are only available in the Specialty Detail version of the network export.
